boundaries: no execution authorized by this file
BHE receives no sealed material before the frozen unsealing condition

B.input: governed_snapshot rendered as the case file, decision_request as the question; no HELM governance structure is described to the model

H0.path: current HELM execution path at the frozen H0 parent commit

H1.authorized_payload_boundary: Mode A: reused governed Decision plus its evidence_ids only. Mode B: governed_state facts named by gate.minimum_sufficient_projection only. Mode C: exactly gate.required_evidence, no neighbors, no inferred evidence. Mode D: the full governed_snapshot as published. Mode E: DISCOVER/WAKE nomination surface only, no adjudication.
H1.path: H1 selected existing path under Adaptive Resolver Aperture v1

harness_binding.discretion: none; mapping is total and fixed before task generation

public_task_schema.canonical_serialization: UTF-8 JSON, keys sorted ascending by code point, separators ',' and ':', no insignificant whitespace, single trailing newline at file level

required_fields.decision_request: object; request_id, gate_or_candidate_id, request_event_type, requested_action, response_contract
required_fields.events: array, ordered turn/event sequence, may be empty
required_fields.governed_snapshot: object; anchor, path, slice, gate, governed_state, authority
required_fields.task_id: string, ^t1-[0-9a-f]{16}$, opaque, carries no stratum information

validation_rules: governed_snapshot_sha256 must equal sha256 of the canonical governed_snapshot
authority_binding must equal the four hidden-authority lookup key fields exactly
every slice.fact_ids entry must resolve inside governed_state.facts
task_id must be unique across the 240-task corpus

sharding.assignment_rule: ascending lexicographic order of opaque task_id, split into six contiguous blocks of 40; assignment is independent of stratum
sharding.leakage_control: shard membership does not encode stratum; every shard contains tasks from all six strata
